name: Timing Analysis
description: Exploitation of data-dependent timing variations in hardware and firmware implementations. Covers measurement of execution time for cryptographic operations, identification of timing leakage in conditional branches, cache-timing attacks on embedded processors, and statistical analysis of timing measurements to extract secrets.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to timing-based side-channel attacks

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands how timing variations leak information about secret data
evidence: Can explain timing attacks against modular exponentiation and table lookups
Understands the concept of constant-time programming and why it matters
Aware of cache-timing attack classes (Flush+Reload, Prime+Probe) at a conceptual level

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Measures and analyzes timing variations on training targets under supervision
evidence: Configures precise timing measurement using GPIO triggers and oscilloscope capture
Measures execution time variation for cryptographic operations with different inputs
Identifies data-dependent timing differences in a reference vulnerable implementation
Applies basic statistical analysis (t-test, histogram analysis) to timing measurements

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently identifies and exploits timing leakage in real targets
evidence: Identifies timing leakage in firmware implementations through measurement and code analysis
Exploits timing side channels to extract key material from vulnerable implementations
Assesses constant-time properties of cryptographic implementations on specific hardware
Produced timing analysis reports on 3+ engagements meeting lab quality standards

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex timing analysis scenarios; develops measurement methodology; mentors team
evidence: Exploits subtle microarchitectural timing leakage (cache, branch predictor) on embedded targets
Develops automated timing leakage detection tools and test harnesses
Assesses the effectiveness of timing countermeasures (constant-time code, blinding) on specific hardware
Mentors junior analysts on timing measurement precision and statistical analysis

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on timing attacks; publishes research; defines timing analysis methodology
evidence: Published research on novel timing attack techniques or microarchitectural leakage
Defines the lab's timing analysis methodology and constant-time verification procedures
Provides expert consultation on timing-safe implementation to development teams
Develops novel timing leakage detection frameworks

assessment_methods.description: Identify and exploit timing leakage in a prepared cryptographic implementation, documenting the measurement setup, statistical analysis, and extracted information
Review timing analysis reports for measurement rigor, statistical validity, and completeness

equipment: ChipWhisperer or equivalent platform with precise timing measurement capability
